facts.fact: The World Bank blog says the Madagascar government is developing an interoperability platform based on X-Road to enable rapid and secure exchange of data between different government information systems, with the civil registration and ID databases as core layers and interoperability planned with the national social registry.

systems.system: CNECI civil registration and identification databases

MDG.note: No date given for the platform's status; published date used as as_of.

facts.fact: The World Bank blog says Namibia adopted the Estonian open-source X-Road software after 2011, so the National Population Register now links functional public and private sector registries, and it was used during COVID-19 to validate identity data for emergency income support.

NAM.note: Adoption year given only as after 2011 and present tense; published date used as as_of.
